title: ALINA v1 visual decomposition and scene grammar
goal: Turn the cinematic ALINA target into an explicit, reusable product composition that M1.2 can render.
why: Bridge the completed M0 engineering foundation to the actual ALINA Control Center product without collapsing independent engines into a monolithic screen.
constraints: Engineering Labs remain diagnostic, not the product homepage
Every visual layer must have semantic purpose
Primary task remains legible in Core tier
acceptanceCriteria: Every target surface maps to a reusable engine/component or a named new requirement
Research, Coding, Security, Presentation and Focus scenarios are defined
Avatar placement is scenario-specific and renderer-independent
Laptop, desktop, ultrawide and narrow behavior are explicit
Core, Enhanced and Cinematic tiers preserve the primary task
Product shell contract is serializable and reason-trace ready
testContract: Every scenario declares exactly one primary module
Every plane has an owning engine
Every cinematic-only capability has a lower-tier fallback
